what_this_is: the canonical_v1 2wiki build whose corpus was the POOLED QUESTION-CONTEXT UNION of the official train/dev/test 'context' fields (398,354 title-deduplicated context paragraphs).
WHY_REJECTED: The user's decision of 2026-09-05 (data/final_canonical/_APPROVALS.json approvals.2wiki) REJECTED 398,354 as the final canonical corpus: it is the pooled question-context universe, i.e. it exists only because questions reference those paragraphs, and it is 6.7% of the corpus the benchmark actually distributes.

The official 2Wiki release states para_with_hyperlink.zip contains ALL articles/paragraphs with hyperlink information except error paragraphs -- that, not the context union, is the complete retrieval corpus.

canonical_v1 was applying a STRICTER standard to HotpotQA (full fullwiki abstracts corpus, distractor-context union rejected) than to 2Wiki (context union accepted). The asymmetry is resolved in favour of the full universe.
The superseded build itself recorded this open flag in its own SOURCE_CONTRACT.json (WHY_THIS_IS_THE_FULL_RETRIEVAL_UNIVERSE -> 'HONEST QUALIFICATION ... USER REVIEW POINT').
WHY_IT_IS_KEPT: the 398,354-row node table is the key that maps the already-computed Dense/SPLADE rows in data/canonical/2wiki/encodings/ onto the new full corpus. It must never be deleted.
note_on_queries: queries/{train,dev,test}.jsonl and queries/lanes/ stay at the TOP level of data/final_canonical/2wiki/ and are regenerated by the full build (same official questions; only the resolved *_node_ids change). The pre-supersession lane files are copied here as queries_lanes_superseded/; the pre-supersession gold_node_ids are recoverable from this directory's nodes.jsonl by supporting-fact title.

BUILDER_SHA_IS_HISTORICAL_NOT_STALE._read_this_before_grepping: This directory's build_info.json / dataset_manifest.json / query_independence_test.json record builder build.py sha256 0879e428a41e636bb4089ef10c8ca217030331e22d54ca1d9dc87ba38988dcd9. That sha is NO LONGER the current build.py. It is deliberately NOT rewritten here.
BUILDER_SHA_IS_HISTORICAL_NOT_STALE.why_not_rewritten: These files are a frozen snapshot of a build that really was produced by builder 0879e428... Rewriting the sha to the current one would make the record claim a build that never happened. A historical record naming the tool that produced it is accurate history, not staleness; the staleness that matters is a FORWARD-LOOKING pin claiming to describe the builder as it is now.
BUILDER_SHA_IS_HISTORICAL_NOT_STALE.what_changed_in_the_builder: the cardinality gold-presence test len(gold_node_ids)==len(gold_refs) was replaced by per-reference resolution semantics. See _WEBQSP_ACCEPTANCE_GATE.json -> 2WIKI_FIX_AT_SOURCE._RESOLVED_2026_09_05.
BUILDER_SHA_IS_HISTORICAL_NOT_STALE.does_it_invalidate_this_snapshot: No. The change is query-side only; this snapshot's corpus (398,354 nodes, corpus_hash ec7fbbe8cd783040) is unaffected, and this build is superseded for an unrelated reason (corpus scope), already documented above.
